title: Application of Cambridge Electric Light Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, §94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 338, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of an interim change in the Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Comapany's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing month of December, 1985. Application is also made by Cambridge Electric Light Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 347. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filling to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
